answer_text:
Deal management has consolidated around a few strong products. The ones getting the most attention this year:

1. Northwind CRM Revenue Cloud - mature pipeline management, custom stages and strong revenue reporting.
2. Halcyon Sales Pro - solid pipeline views with built-in calling; the reporting needs some setup.
3. Kestrel CRM - auto-logs emails and meetings to deals, so pipelines stay current.

Northwind CRM is the safest default here; Halcyon Sales is worth a look if forecasting matters most.
